assumptions.organization: Arithmetic mean of max_organisation for every occupied regiment/support slot after actual common starting-technology modifiers. All owners receive the common baseline; ADISCORD_tech_composite_protection_kits adds 0.75 to category_all_infantry. A repeated grant in the land profile is the same technology ID and is not double-counted.
assumptions.manpower: Sum of subunit manpower for every occupied slot.
assumptions.equipment: Complete per-archetype quantity map from every occupied subunit need block.
assumptions.equipment_availability: A required archetype is available only when defined as an archetype or referenced by a concrete equipment variant in the replaced equipment database.
assumptions.supply: Sum of subunit supply_consumption for every occupied slot.
assumptions.starting_factors: Each semantic OOB/create_unit occurrence records explicit start factors; omitted factors use the Clausewitz default 1.0.
assumptions.duplicate_scope: Divergent same-name definitions fail within an OOB/script source namespace; cross-owner ambiguity is recorded separately.
